description: Live calibration against the real Gemini API: real embedContent and real generateContent calls, run sequentially with a pause between calls so a burst does not just collect provider 429s. This is the only tier that spends Google API quota, and it is the calibration source for Tier C.
provenance: RECONSTRUCTED, not freshly measured. The original file was lost when the task-4 worktree was removed after merge, since bench/results/ is gitignored and lived inside it. Every latency value below was recovered verbatim from the raw sample tables committed in docs/BENCHMARKS.md, so the numbers are the real 2026-08-15 measurements. Two things could not be recovered: the verbatim provider error strings, which were deliberately never committed because they can carry a request URL or credential, and the environment block, which is unused by the report. Re-run `npm run bench:live` if you want a file with first-hand provenance. Failure entries are categories under the new capture-time classification; the original run predated it and its verbatim messages were never committed.
